parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $P(13.8<X<15.8)$: use $(13.8-14.8)/1.5$ and/or $(15.8-14.8)/1.5$. M1 substitute 14.8 and 1.5 and either 13.8 or 15.8 appropriately in one $\pm$ standardising formula; not $\sigma^2$ or $\sqrt{\sigma}$ and no continuity correction. SCM1 condones using 14.3 or 15.3 instead. Probability $=2\Phi(0.6667)-1=2(0.7477)-1=0.4954$. M1 appropriate area from their $z$-values, expect less than 0.5. A1 AWRT 0.495; if one or both M marks not awarded, SCB1 for AWRT 0.495 SOI. Expected days $=0.4954\times5\times45=111.465$, so 111 days. B1FT strictly their at least 4-figure probability times 225; one integer, expect 111 or 112; no indication of approximation such as $\approx$, about or 3SF. Total: 4.
